This journal is a place for the owner’s real story. Replace these pages with the experiences, motivations, and perspective that make the work personal.

data.title: How I work
data.subtitle: Understand. Build. Learn.
data.body:
01 / Understand the constraint
Ask what matters, who it matters to, and what a useful outcome would look like.

02 / Build something useful
Choose a small, complete path through the problem. Keep the parts easy to explain.

03 / Measure, then improve
Watch what happens, listen carefully, and let evidence shape the next decision.

Sample working principles, ready to personalize.
